in_sanskrit.name: ध्युतिमन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is radiant with knowledge and wisdom

in_marathi.name: Dhyutiman
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhyutiman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhyutiman means 'luminous' or 'full of light'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dhyuti' meaning 'light' and 'man' meaning 'full of'.

in_bengali.name: Dhyutiman
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dhyutiman একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Dhyutiman means 'luminous' or 'full of light'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dhyuti' meaning 'light' and 'man' meaning 'full of'.
